system.notes:
Beautiful fey maiden born of rivers and streams. Constantly dripping water. Has a gossamer-threaded shawl that harbors her life essence, always worn or hidden.

AC 13, HP 19, ATK 1 slam +0 (1) or kiss, MV near (swim), S -1, D +2, C +1, I +1, W +3, Ch +4, AL N, LV 4

Beguile. The nereid can choose to beguile all mortals within near who behold her, CHA 18+ or charmed for 1d6 hours.

Kiss. Kiss a helpless or willing target, filling their lungs with water. CON 18+ or go to 0 HP with a death timer of 1. Can instead bestow water breathing for 1d4 days.

Waterborn. Can become invisible when submerged in running water.
